question: What does a fuel's octane rating actually measure?
answer: An octane rating does not measure how good a fuel is. It measures resistance to knocking, which is when a fuel-air mix ignites on its own before the spark. Iso-octane takes far more squeezing than n-heptane, so it was set at 100 and n-heptane at 0.
move: Octane measures resistance to knocking, not the quality of the fuel.
